lines.quote: Trump winning means no war. War is simply not in the cards.
lines.subject: siegfriedmuell
lines.why: Forecasts that no war will happen during the Trump term.

lines.quote: Anyone talking about war with Iran is just out to lunch.
lines.subject: siegfriedmuell
lines.why: Dismisses war talk as baseless, which again says no war will come.

lines.quote: Israel going to war with Iran without us is somehow proving me wrong?
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: Israel going to war with Iran
lines.why: Argues that an Israeli war without the US does not count against the no-US-war claim.

lines.quote: no war with Iran, no nukes.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: States that there is currently no war for the US.

lines.quote: until then, I'm right yet again
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Speaks of the speaker's own record of being right, not of the war.

lines.quote: That didn't happen - that WONT happen
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Says the feared US ground war and casualties did not occur and will not, despite the strikes.

lines.quote: Many of us made our voices loud and clear that we didn't want to be embroiled in a forever war
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: Many of us made our voices loud
lines.why: Defends the speaker's side's own record and motives.

lines.quote: Many denouncing Trump and MAGA were doing so because they're personally invested in seeing the administration fail.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Attributes motives to critics, which is a claim about who is to blame, not a reading.

lines.quote: You guys had all those big spaces and posts about regime change, nuclear strikes and Americans dying for Israel.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Points to the predicted escalation as not having come true, implying the war stayed contained.

lines.quote: No "war with Iran."
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Says there is no war with Iran, which reads as the no-war promise holding, though US strikes had already happened on 2025-06-22.

lines.quote: we got the biggest ever increase in ICE and border funding possible. Thank you TRUMP!
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: biggest ever increase in ICE and border funding
lines.why: Credits Trump for immigration funding, a matter of credit and loyalty that no body series measures.

lines.quote: If there's a single US boot dropped on Iran during Trump's presidency, I'll make a video denouncing the entire MAGA movement.
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lit: single US boot dropped on Iran
lines.why: A conditional pledge about the speaker's own loyalty to MAGA, not a reading of the war.

lines.quote: Immigration is the greatest issue we face in the West.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: greatest issue we face in the West
lines.why: A priority claim about immigration, which is not on the body and not about the Iran war.

lines.quote: All of these people listed are pro immigration. I don't care if they're "based anti zionists" - they're the enemy
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Names enemies by loyalty and allegiance rather than by any reading of the object.

lines.quote: there are no "boots on the ground" in Iran
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: no "boots on the ground" in Iran
lines.why: Counters critics by saying the war is air-only with no ground troops, which still leaves the war on.

lines.quote: these liars know this, they just want to score internet points for headpats from cult leader figures
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Attacks the critics' motives rather than any reading of the war.

lines.quote: I think boots on ground would be a big mistake and still do!
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: boots on ground would be a big mistake
lines.why: Judges that a ground escalation of the war would be a mistake.

lines.quote: But we have to see how this plays out.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: we have to see how this plays out
lines.why: Holds judgment on the war open, with no date or direction given.

lines.quote: Of course there are no boots on the ground in Iran
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lit: no boots on the ground in Iran
lines.why: States that the war so far involves no ground troops, which still leaves the war on.

lines.quote: even if there were, I don't care anymore. As long as He controls immigration, I don't care what happens.
lines.subject: captivedreamer7
lit: As long as He controls immigration
lines.why: Drops his earlier pledge against boots on the ground out of loyalty to Trump on immigration.

lines.quote: I'm skeptical of these strikes
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Doubts the strikes, which reads the war as going badly.

lines.quote: we should in no universe have boots on the ground in Iran
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: in no universe have boots on the ground
lines.why: Says a ground escalation must be ruled out.

lines.quote: let's hope this resolves quickly
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Hopes the war ends within weeks, which is a soft forecast of resolution.

lines.quote: I'm willing to give Trump the benefit of the doubt.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: Extends trust to Trump despite his own skepticism, which concerns the speaker's loyalty and not the war reading.

lines.quote: The price one pays for nuance on this app:
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: The price one pays for nuance
lines.why: Complains about how he is treated for nuance, which is about the speaker and his critics and not the war.

lines.quote: All these people do is lie - ive said the same
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: All these people do is lie
lines.why: This is a claim about others' honesty and the speaker's own consistency, not a reading of the war itself.

lines.quote: now that it's happening I hope it is resolved quickly and we can move onto other things
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: The speaker accepts the war is under way and hopes for a quick end, with no date given.

lines.quote: I think it would be a massive mistake for some boots on the ground invasion of Iran.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: This restates a long-held view that a ground invasion would be a mistake, which is a past position and not a reading of the present.

lines.quote: Clearly that's not happening and there's very little chance it will happen.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: very little chance it will happen
lines.why: The line says the war has not escalated to a ground invasion and is unlikely to, a mild relief within the ongoing war.

lines.quote: I explicitly opposed the Iran war from the outset
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: This is the speaker's own record on the war, not a reading of it.

lines.quote: didn't call any reasonable critics "third worldists."
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lit: This is very disappointing to see from you
lines.why: The speaker denies something said about them, which concerns their own record.

lines.quote: The people attacking me daily were these retard righters.
lines.subject: captive_dreamer
lines.why: The line names who attacks the speaker, which is about loyalties and blame, not the war's state.
